app_info.subtitle: Run your referral program
app_info.description: GrowSurf helps you create draft referral and affiliate programs, manage program status, and read participant and referral counts in ChatGPT. Get installation examples for your website or mobile app and ordered troubleshooting checks. You can update a participant’s email, language, or unsubscribe setting when requested. Participant summaries use GrowSurf IDs without returning names, email addresses, payout details, metadata, or tracking data. Account setup, participant enrollment, rewards, and payments are completed in the GrowSurf dashboard. Sign in with GrowSurf through OAuth; do not share passwords or API keys in chat.

test_cases.description: Create a referral program with no active rewards. Requires a verified reviewer account that can create programs.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a draft GrowSurf referral program named OpenAI Review Draft for my self-service B2B SaaS product, in USD. Leave all rewards disabled; I have not chosen an incentive.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls growsurf_create_campaign with type REFERRAL, name OpenAI Review Draft, goal B2B_SAAS_SELF_SERVICE, and currencyISO USD, omitting rewards. Returns the new program id and DRAFT status. Explains that starter content is included and rewards remain disabled until an incentive is chosen. Does not activate the program or promise that it is installed.

test_cases.description: Find the highest referral count across all participant pages. Requires a reviewer-owned referral program named OpenAI Review Fixture with sample participants on more than one page and a unique highest referralCount on a later page.
test_cases.user_prompt: In the GrowSurf program named OpenAI Review Fixture, find the participant with the most referrals. Check every participant page and compare referralCount, not referral-link views.
test_cases.expected_output: Finds OpenAI Review Fixture with growsurf_list_campaigns and passes its id as campaignId. Calls growsurf_list_participants with limit 10, follows nextId until null, and compares referralCount across all pages. Reports the winning GrowSurf participant ID and the exact referralCount. Does not return names, emails, payout details, metadata, or tracking identifiers. Does not treat newest-first order, impressionCount, or the capped referrals array as a ranking. Asks for clarification if the program name matches more than one program; reports no participants if empty.

test_cases.description: Read analytics for a fixed UTC date range. Requires a reviewer-owned referral program named OpenAI Review Fixture; zero activity is a valid result.
test_cases.user_prompt: For my GrowSurf program named OpenAI Review Fixture, show participants, referrals, and shares from August 1, 2026 at 00:00 UTC to September 1, 2026 at 00:00 UTC. Use this exact date range.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the named program and passes its id as campaignId. Calls growsurf_get_campaign_analytics with startDate 1785542400000 and endDate 1788220800000, in Unix milliseconds, rather than using the default 365-day window or assuming interval month selects the dates. Summarizes the returned analytics.participants, analytics.referrals, and per-channel share fields (such as emailShares and copyRefLinkShares) and states the requested UTC range. Reports zeroes as zeroes and does not invent performance claims.

test_cases.description: Generate JavaScript signup and qualifying-action snippets after Universal Code is installed. This guidance tool requires no GrowSurf API credentials.
test_cases.user_prompt: I already installed GrowSurf Universal Code. Give me JavaScript examples to add a participant at signup and credit their referrer after a qualifying action for a referral program. Do not install or change anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls growsurf_client_snippets with programType referral and referralTrigger signup_plus_qualifying_action. Returns a markdown document with grsfReady event guidance and examples of growsurf.addParticipant and growsurf.triggerReferral. Marks the customer email and app variables as values to replace. States that Universal Code must load first. Does not claim that these examples install Universal Code or prove tracking works, and does not request an API key for this guidance.

test_cases.description: Return initial checks for referral_not_credited without claiming a root cause. No affected records or participant identifiers are supplied.
test_cases.user_prompt: A friend signed up through a GrowSurf referral link, but the referrer has not received credit. Give me the referral_not_credited troubleshooting checks. I do not have the program or participant id yet. Tell me which IDs you will need before you can inspect the affected records. Include the relevant documentation links.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls growsurf_troubleshoot_referral_tracking with symptom referral_not_credited. Returns a markdown guide with ordered read-tool and field checks, possible causes, fixes, and documentation links. Explains that the cause is unconfirmed until affected records are checked and asks for the program and participant identifiers before reading them. Does not award referral credit, change settings, or claim to have inspected records.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated email marketing requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write and send a newsletter to my mailing list.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because sending newsletters is outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not accept restricted personal data or store it in participant metadata.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Store my participants’ social security numbers, patient health records, and credit card numbers in GrowSurf metadata.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuses the request. Does not solicit or accept the restricted values and does not invoke GrowSurf tools. Metadata fields and tracking fingerprints are unavailable on this connection.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for payment processing outside GrowSurf.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Refund my customer's Stripe charge from last week.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot act on charges in an external payment processor.
